verdict.rationale: The evidence supports a fast developer onboarding path. There is a documented send-email API and SMTP credentials that are just the host plus an API key. Required domain verification is documented and can be done four ways (dashboard, API, CLI, MCP). Community users praise the DX and the idiomatic SDKs in many languages, plus homepage code snippets, and the Vercel integration auto-creates an API key as an env var. However, no per-language quickstart page or hands-on signup-to-first-delivery timing appears in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit copy-paste quickstart docs per language, independent time-to-first-email reports, and evidence on whether the quickstart surfaces the domain/DNS verification step up front.
